GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you drop.

Is it actually free?

Yes. The beta is free, including downloads and small batches. You don’t need an account or a payment card. There are no paid plans in this version.

What happens to my photos?

Your photos are processed in browser memory and aren’t uploaded to us. Clearing your photos or closing the tab removes the working copies. The browser may cache the cutting engine, but we don’t save your photos in that cache. Downloaded files stay wherever you save them.

Will it work on every photo?

It works best with a distinct subject against a simple background. Fine hair, transparent materials, overlapping objects, and low contrast can be difficult. Always preview the result. This beta uses a lightweight model so it can run on your own device.

What can I download?

PNG files with transparent or white backgrounds. Keep the original proportions (up to 4096 px on the longest side), or center your cutout on a 1080 × 1080 square or a 1080 × 1350 portrait canvas. Batch downloads contain a separate PNG for each successful cutout.

Why does the first photo take longer?

Your browser first downloads the image-processing engine and a roughly 4.6 MB model. Processing speed depends on your device. Keep this tab open while it works. If loading fails, check your connection and use Retry.
